description: The portfolio's shared configuration, extended by name. It replaces the `kotlin toolchain` and `kotlinx` groups — the preset's `kotlin` rule matches the same compiler coordinates and the jvm, multiplatform and serialization plugin ids — along with the schedule, the limits and the labels. The Monday batch moves from 9am to 6am with the rest of the portfolio.

KSP is the one part of that group the preset does NOT cover, so it is put back below: it is versioned against the compiler (2.3.11 here against Kotlin 2.3), and a mismatched pair fails the build rather than reporting a version problem. It joins the preset's `kotlin` group by name, which is what keeps them in one pull request.

Automerge is a separate preset (`github>youndie/sborka:automerge-harness`) and is not extended: nothing merges itself here today. Its precondition holds — build.yaml runs on `pull_request` — so it can be added as its own change.

packageRules.description: KSP moves with the compiler, so it joins the preset's kotlin group rather than arriving on its own.
Ktor server modules share one version.
Exposed core/jdbc/json go in as a single version.

Major updates get their own PR: they cannot be merged without looking. Stricter than the preset, which labels majors and leaves them open — here they wait on the dashboard until somebody asks for the branch.
